theorem_title: Length of a retained choice tuple partition word
formal_statement: theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.partitionWord_length {h J : ℕ} (t : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawIncidences.ChoiceTuple h J) : (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.partitionWord t).length = J := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For natural $h,J$ and any retained global choice tuple $t$ with $J$ blocks, its partition-word representation has exactly one entry per block:

$$|\operatorname{partitionWord}(t)|=J.$$

This aligns the original combinatorial tuple representation with fixed-width reporting prefixes.
